text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Mhm, thanks ze ze. Yep, I'll call again later.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Was that a birthday call from your big
sister in
Hong Kong?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my sisters and parents have been

bombarding me with calls and texts ever
since the
date changed... Heh, it's
hectic, but I wouldn't
have it any other
way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I mean that's true... but I also
think they're
a little worried about me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They think I must be so lonely being all
alone in
Japan on my birthday... Ahaha, I
have to tell them
I'm not a kid anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, we'll throw you a birthday
party,
Crown! A big one, with everyone!
Right, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You can think of me and Cheval just like
family!
Right, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
F-family? Me?! I-I don't know... Would
you even
want that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, of course! I'd love that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now that I have family in Japan to celebrate with, I'll have to tell ze ze and the others that they have nothing to worry about. ♪
